caption: The drawing depicts a large, central figure of a man with brown skin, black hair and beard, and mustache, who is crucified on a cross. The cross is colored in gray, red, and black with beige endcaps. The man's arms are outstretched and nailed to the horizontal beam of the cross; he wears a red and green garment with yellow and black accents, blue leggings, and boots with red and blue detailing. Below and in front of the crucified figure, there is a row of seven smaller human figures standing on a red horizontal base. These figures are dressed in brown, red, pink, beige, and black clothing. Two of the smaller figures appear to be holding long black staffs or spears, and one figure on the far right holds a drum. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Plate 29: Saint Acacius: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
